title: Memorandum of the Controller's Office: Retain Rates, Equity Floors and Ceilings on the Membership and Patronage Equity Classes
content:
The figures in this memorandum are the ones the cooperative's books carry for each class of Membership and Patronage Equity: the rate at which capital is retained on a qualifying unit, the streams that rate is taken on, the equity a class must keep to stay open, the equity above which the board declines further retention, and whether a written certificate is drawn for the retained equity.

| Class | Capital retained a unit, USD | Streams the retain is taken on | Equity the class must carry to remain open, USD | Equity above which no further retention is taken, USD | Written certificate drawn |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | 0.000 | none | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Class A Voting Membership | 0.003 | grain bushels; crop input dollars | 25.00 | 500000.00 | yes |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | 0.003 | grain bushels; crop input dollars; refined fuel gallons | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | yes |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | 0.000 | none | 0.00 | 1000000.00 | yes |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | 0.003 | grain bushels; crop input dollars | 25.00 | 500000.00 | yes |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | 0.000 | none | 0.00 | 1000000.00 | no |

Three classes carry a retain rate of 0.003 a unit and three carry 0.000. A class whose third column reads none takes no capital retain at all, whatever its rate column shows.

The one class that takes the retain on three streams is the Class B Preferred Equity Membership, whose refined fuel gallons subscribe capital alongside grain bushels and crop input dollars. The two other retaining classes take it on grain bushels and crop input dollars only.

**On the floor and the ceiling.** The fourth column is the equity the class must carry to remain open; the fifth is the equity above which the board declines further retention on the class. A Class B Preferred Equity Membership standing at 1200.00 of equity is above its floor of 1000.00 and far below its ceiling of 1000000.00. A Class A Voting Membership standing at 20.00 is below its floor of 25.00.
